name: Freedom Lend
funder: Columbus Capital Pty Ltd (ACL 337303) trading as Origin Mortgage Management Services; issued by Perpetual Corporate Trust Limited (ACL 392673)

assessmentBufferPct.note: Not published. Checked the Freedom Lend TMD set (Variable, Fixed, SMSF, Construction) and the FAQ / compare-our-home-loans pages — no buffer, floor rate, DTI cap or rent shading is stated.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: "Maximum LVR — 95% (the maximum LVR is met in accordance with the requirements notified by the Issuer from time to time)." Corroborated on the Freedom Lend FAQ: "Freedom Lend allow for up to 95% loan-to-value ratio (LVR)."

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: The TMD states a single 95% LVR attribute across "Prime – Owner Occupied or Investment Loans" and does not split the cap by purpose.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend — FAQs, "What is the minimum amount of deposit required..."
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: "Freedom Lend loans have no LMI for loans to 80% or lower Lender to Value Ratio (LVR) and 70% or lower LVR for high density locations." Undated page; asAt is the date read.

highDensityPolicy.value: In high-density locations the LMI-free threshold drops from 80% LVR to 70% LVR.
highDensityPolicy.note: This is the no-LMI threshold, not a maximum-LVR cap; Freedom Lend does not publish a maximum LVR for high-density security or define 'high density'.

maxLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
maxLoanAmount.note: "Max Loan size $3.5m (the loan amount meets the stated minimum and maximum loan amount requirements notified by the Issuer from time to time)."

minLoanAmount.note: The TMD defers the minimum to "requirements notified by the Issuer from time to time" and does not publish it. The comparison-rate example uses a $150,000 loan, which is an illustration, not a minimum.

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025

maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.note: "Up to 60 months (interest only repayments)" on the Prime product. Construction loans are interest-only for 12 months with extension available.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
offsetAvailable.note: "Offset Facility — A transactional sub-account is available and linked to the home loan", with an optional Visa Debit Card for Australian residents.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
redrawAvailable.note: Redraw available; on construction loans only after construction is complete.

constructionAvailable.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), effective 30 September 2025
constructionAvailable.note: "Prime Construction — Owner Occupied or Investment Loans"; also covers house-and-land packages, off-the-plan purchases and modular homes built by accredited builders.

smsfLendingAvailable.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend — Target Market Determinations index (SMSF TMD 202512)
smsfLendingAvailable.note: A current SMSF TMD is published; its contents were not read, so no SMSF LVR or loan-size figure is recorded.

guarantorAccepted.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), Eligibility Criteria
guarantorAccepted.note: Eligibility contemplates "guarantor who supports the loan also meets our lending eligibility criteria", and borrowers above the deposit threshold "will pay Lenders Mortgage Insurance or have an acceptable guarantor". Guarantor conditions are not published.

rules.sourceTitle: Freedom Lend Target Market Determination — Variable (Prime), Eligibility Criteria
rules.note: "is either an Australian Citizen or a Permanent Resident of Australia". Borrowers must be individuals (single or joint) aged 18 or over. Temporary-visa and non-resident cases are not addressed, so no rule has been recorded for them.

gaps: Freedom Lend publishes no broker page, broker portal or accreditation path and sells direct to consumers; status recorded as research_only. The underlying Columbus/Origin TMD does list "Third party – Mortgage Managers and Accredited Mortgage Brokers" as a distribution channel, so the product is broker-distributable through Columbus even though Freedom Lend itself is the direct-to-consumer mortgage manager.
No servicing parameters published at all.
No income-type table, shading percentages, alt-doc or self-employed policy published.
No credit-history policy published — the FAQ answer to "Can I get a mortgage if I had a credit default?" refers the enquiry to a consultant rather than stating a policy.
Minimum loan amount is deferred to the Issuer and is not published.
No definition of "high density locations" behind the 70% no-LMI threshold, and no maximum LVR for high-density security.
No security policy published — property types, minimum unit size, rural, postcode categories.
No genuine savings or gifted deposit policy published.
